name: OpenDrive
description_en:
OpenDrive combines hosted file storage, backup tasks, synchronization and sharing, with Notes and Tasks as adjacent services. Its desktop applications and web access have different capabilities. A backup task and a two-way sync task do not have the same deletion behavior.

This profile examines OpenDrive Drive for personal and business file workflows. The appropriate plan depends on file size, download bandwidth, users and intended use, not only the word “unlimited.” No application or upload was tested.
description_zh:
OpenDrive 把托管文件存储、备份任务、同步和共享结合起来，另有 Notes 与 Tasks 相邻服务。桌面应用和网页访问能力不同，备份任务与双向同步的删除行为也不同。

本文分析 OpenDrive Drive 的个人和商用文件流程。套餐选择取决于文件大小、下载带宽、用户及用途，不能只看“无限”。本文未测试应用或上传。

sections.title_en: Choose backup or sync before deleting files
sections.title_zh: 删除文件前先区分备份与同步
sections.en:
The FAQ defines sync as two-way mirroring: deleting a file inside a sync task propagates to OpenDrive. A backup task does not apply that same deletion behavior. The Windows app lists scheduled tasks, notifications, file versions and restore controls.

For a pilot, create separate disposable backup and sync folders, upload a known file, change and delete it, then verify the expected remote state and recovery. Do not use your only copy to discover the difference. Conflicting edits from two users are not automatically merged according to the FAQ.
sections.zh:
FAQ 将同步定义为双向镜像，同步任务内删除文件会传播到 OpenDrive，备份任务则不采用相同删除行为。Windows 应用列有任务调度、通知、版本及恢复控制。

试点可分别创建可丢弃备份与同步目录，上传已知文件、修改再删除，核对远程状态和恢复。不要用唯一副本试探差异。FAQ 还说明两用户冲突修改不会自动合并。

sections.title_en: Encryption and access paths have boundaries
sections.title_zh: 加密与访问路径有边界
sections.en:
The FAQ says Secure Files Folder is accessible through Windows or Mac applications, not the web interface, mobile apps or WebDAV. Do not assume every advertised access path can read the same encrypted folder. For accidental deletion, start with Trash; the FAQ describes a support-assisted recovery window after emptying it, not a guaranteed instant recovery.

Before rollout, test the actual restore method, available temporary space and required credentials. Read task logs and inspect the destination rather than treating task completion as proof that every expected file is recoverable.
sections.zh:
FAQ 说明 Secure Files Folder 通过 Windows 或 Mac 应用访问，网页、移动应用或 WebDAV 不可访问，不能假定所有宣传入口都能读取同一加密目录。误删先检查回收站；清空后 FAQ 说明可联系支持在窗口内恢复，并非即时恢复保证。

采用前需测试真实恢复方式、临时空间及凭据，查看任务日志并检查目标，不能仅凭任务完成就认为所有预期文件均可恢复。

sections.title_en: Read capacity together with usage restrictions
sections.title_zh: 容量需连同使用限制阅读
sections.en:
The Free plan lists 5 GB, a 100-MB file limit, 1 GB daily bandwidth and 200 KB/s speed. The retrieved Personal offer shows USD 12.95 monthly or USD 129 yearly, with user selection affecting cost. The FAQ defines bandwidth as downloads, not uploads.

The current terms restrict Unlimited plans to ordinary personal or office use and exclude such cases as whole NAS/SAN or data-centre backup, directing those to other plans. Excessive use can lead to throttling or termination. Consequently, “unlimited” is not permission for an arbitrary archive workload. Confirm the exact plan, user count, renewal and taxes; no universal payable price is set.
sections.zh:
免费方案列 5 GB、单文件 100 MB、每日带宽 1 GB、速度 200 KB/s。读取的 Personal 报价为月付 12.95 美元或年付 129 美元，用户选择影响费用。FAQ 将带宽定义为下载而非上传。

当前条款把 Unlimited 限于普通个人或办公用途，整套 NAS／SAN 或数据中心备份等应使用其他方案；过量使用可被限速或终止。因此，“无限”不代表允许任意档案工作负载。需确认具体套餐、用户、续费及税费，本文不填写通用实付价。

sections.title_en: Match the workflow to the plan and client
sections.title_zh: 按套餐和客户端匹配流程
sections.en:
Shortlist OpenDrive for file storage with explicit task and sharing control when its plan and client restrictions fit. A business needing application-consistent server recovery or guaranteed restore deadlines needs additional evidence. Notes and Tasks do not by themselves strengthen backup coverage.

The license page grants service-use rights under restrictions rather than establishing an open-source grant. No client restore, security audit or performance benchmark was performed. Confirm exact supported OS versions, version-retention policy, regional data handling and support commitments before relying on the service for a critical recovery.
sections.zh:
在套餐与客户端限制符合需求时，可考虑 OpenDrive 用于文件存储、任务和共享控制。需要应用一致性服务器恢复或保证恢复期限的企业，还需更多证据。Notes 和 Tasks 本身不会增强备份覆盖。

许可页面是在限制下授予服务使用权，不能证明开源授权。本文未执行客户端恢复、安全审计或性能测试，关键恢复前应确认 OS 版本、版本保留、区域数据处理和支持承诺。
